hook.name: MUGENHookV1
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the MUGEN/ETH pool that collects fees on every swap and burns MUGEN tokens. On buys (ETH→MUGEN), 1% of the MUGEN output is taken and burned directly. On sells (MUGEN→ETH), 5% of the ETH output triggers a nested buyback swap (ETH→MUGEN) inside afterSwap, and the purchased MUGEN is burned. Only exact-input swaps are supported.
